instruction: Can you increase the maximum volume slider limit in VLC to 200 percent? The default maximum is not loud enough for my quiet audio files.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the maximum volume setting in VLC to 200%. The evaluator checks if qt-max-volume is set to 200 in the VLC configuration file. Similar difficulty to original task, requiring access to VLC preferences.
metadata.verification: Verified using existing check_qt_max_volume metric function. Expected value: qt-max-volume=200 in vlcrc configuration file.
